name: Holds Organizations Policy
description: An AWS Organizations organization holds a customer-managed policy of a type other than SCP (organization -> policy): RCP, tag policy, declarative policy and the rest of the PolicyType enum, one organizations:ListPolicies(Filter=<type>) per type enabled on the root. Containment, for customer-managed policies only. All the per-type listings share one parent and one edge type, so they are recorded as ONE completeness surface, complete only when the root's enabled policy types were read and every per-type listing read to its end (req-aws-core-organizations-completeness-14).
